newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-G to issue 1.4 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-G to issue 1.4 mln new shares.

text.p: Polish construction company Mostostal Gdansk SA plans to issue 1.4 million shares ex-rights in June to raise about 20 million zlotys, a company official said on Tuesday.
The head of the firm's analytical department Juliusz Adroszko told Reuters the management's proposal would be voted on by the firm's general shareholders meeting on April 26.
"We are planning to issue 1.4 million shares, we would like them to be ex-rights as it always speeds up the issue process," he said. Currently Mostostal Gdansk has 2.6 million shares outstanding.
Adroszko said the funds from the issue would be earmarked for new acquisitions and machinery purchases.
He said the issue price would be set through book building but said it was too early to reveal any other details.

Adroszko also said the firm did not plan a 1996 payout and wanted to earmark all its last year's net profit of 2.2 million zlotys for reserve capital. He added the firm, which did not pay a dividend last year, might consider a payout next year.
